summary: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, announcing that its board of directors resolved to convene a Special Meeting of Shareholders on June 17, 2026, and mailed a Management Proxy Circular to shareholders. The filing is a routine notice of a shareholder meeting and proxy circular, not a special situation event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics are present. This is a standard governance filing for a foreign private issuer reporting under the 1934 Act.
